collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager gathering herbs is caught at the forest edge as night falls: walk home fast, or stand still and listen.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) was gathering herbs at the edge of the forest and lost track of time. Now the light is going, and the jungle has started making its evening noises: clicks, rustles, a long, low hoot, something that might be a frog or might not. None of it is dangerous, probably. (name1)'s heart is pounding anyway.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) makes (him/her)self stop and listen. The hoot is an owl. The clicks are insects. The rustle is a little ground bird, scratching. The thing that might be a frog is definitely a frog. (He/she) is still frightened, but now (he/she) knows what (he/she) is frightened of. (He/she) walks home steadily.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) walks home very fast, not quite running, not looking back. Every rustle makes (him/her) jump. (He/she) reaches the village just as the first fires are lit, and stands in the light, breathing hard. (He/she) feels foolish. (He/she) also feels glad to be home, and decides the second feeling matters more.
